tourNote: A short tour explains the screen once your matrix is open.

where.title: Where do you want to keep your ideas?
where.intro: Idea Matrix has no accounts and no server of its own. Your matrix is one file, and you choose where it lives. You can open a different file later from Settings.
where.needsChromeBody: Your browser can’t save changes back to a file on disk, so this option is off. Open this page in Chrome or Edge to use it, or keep your ideas in Google Drive, which works in any browser.
where.localText: A file you can see, back up, or keep in your iCloud, Dropbox or Drive folder.
where.driveText: Any browser, including your phone. The app only sees the one file it creates or you open.
where.dropboxText: A visible Apps/Idea Matrix folder in your Dropbox.

file.title: Open a matrix you already have, or create a new one?
file.openDriveText: You already have a matrix file in your Drive, maybe from another computer. Google asks you to sign in, then a picker shows your JSON files. Picking one is what gives the app access to it, and to nothing else in your Drive.
file.lastStep: This is the last step: your matrix opens as it is.
file.createDriveText: Google asks you to sign in, then the file is created:
file.newFolder: In a new folder at the top of My Drive, called
file.pickFolder: In a folder I choose (a picker opens)
file.oneMoreStep: One more step: what goes in the new file.
file.openLocalText: You already have a matrix file, maybe from another computer or a backup. The picker shows JSON files, and the app checks that the one you choose really is a matrix before loading it.
file.createLocalText: A save dialog opens so you pick the folder and name. The suggested name is ideas.ideamatrix.json.

start.title: What should go in it?
start.saved: <file/> is saved {{where}}. It is empty until you choose what goes in it.
start.exampleText: Nine fictional ideas, already scored, so you can see what a filled-in matrix looks like before adding your own. Park them whenever you like.
start.emptyText: Just the columns. You’ll add your first idea from the matrix, after a short tour.

progress.oneMore: + one more step if you create a new file
